messages.subject: Project Larkspur / Kestrel House, Reading - buyer's solicitors
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Jonathan,

We act for Marchwood Property Group Limited on the purchase of the freehold of Kestrel House, 14 Forbury Road, Reading from your client Brantwood Asset Management Limited.

Please send the draft contract, official copies, the tenancy documents and your replies to CPSE.1 when ready. We'll be ordering searches this week.

Kind regards
Elena Marchetti

Elena Marchetti
Associate - Real Estate
Whitfield Carter LLP

Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

Dear Elena,

Noted, thank you. We'll send the draft contract and a data room link shortly. Official copies for title BK482176 are with the engrossment; the registered Northbank charge will be discharged on completion and we'll provide the usual undertaking.

Replies to CPSE.1 will follow next week.

Regards

Partner
Castle & Vane LLP
